controller.mapping_summary: Historical redream libretro profile maps Dreamcast legacy controller inputs, including d-pad, face buttons, triggers and analog stick.

firmware.notes: RetroDream core-info requires both dc/boot.bin and dc/flash.bin and publishes their MD5 digests.

saves.naming: Dreamcast VMU persistent images use vmu0.bin/vmu1.bin-style slot names in the Redream core's data directory.
saves.notes: Game records live inside VMU images rather than one per-title SRAM file.

states.naming: RetroArch frontend state names are <content-basename>.state and <content-basename>.stateN when supported.
states.notes: retrodream_libretro.info does not publish a savestate_features value in the pinned record.
